items.stem: ChatGPT proposes a fix for a bug you cannot reproduce. What should you do before shipping it?

options.text: Reproduce the bug and confirm the fix resolves it against the real program
options.rationale: Correct: a suggested fix must be verified against the actual failing behaviour before release.

options.text: Ship it because the explanation sounded convincing
options.rationale: A convincing explanation is not evidence the fix works.

options.text: Ask the model to rate its own confidence and trust that
options.rationale: Self-reported confidence does not verify real behaviour.

options.text: Rewrite the whole module to be safe
options.rationale: A large rewrite adds risk and still is not verification.

items.explanation: Correct: a suggested fix must be verified against the actual failing behaviour before release.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Why ask ChatGPT for a minimal diff rather than a full rewrite when fixing a bug?

options.text: A small, scoped change is easier to review and less likely to introduce new defects
options.rationale: Correct: minimal diffs keep review tractable and limit blast radius.

options.text: Smaller changes always run faster at runtime
options.rationale: Diff size does not determine runtime performance.

options.text: The model cannot produce large outputs
options.rationale: Models can produce large outputs; that is not the reason.
Rewrites can be correct; the issue is reviewability and risk, not correctness in principle.

items.explanation: Correct: minimal diffs keep review tractable and limit blast radius.

items.stem: Which TWO inputs should be removed before pasting a log into a consumer ChatGPT session? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: credentials must never be pasted into a consumer chat.
Correct: personal data should be redacted to protect confidentiality and comply with policy.
The error type carries no secret and is needed for diagnosis.

options.text: The line number of the failure
options.rationale: A line number is not sensitive and helps locate the bug.

items.explanation: Correct: credentials must never be pasted into a consumer chat.
